name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.137.0 — The client route is now a dedicated journey player, not the served review page restated: /client/index.html lists every journey with how many of the session's guesses are still open on it, and /client/walk/<j>.html walks one screen at a time in a frame, advanced by the mock's own real control, with the session's guesses shown beside it as 合ってる/違う marks, a free note box, the gray states one click away, and an approve control unlocked only by reaching the last screen with every guess answered — one typed sentence closes it. Wrong clicks are recorded per screen and never shown to the client. design/mocks/walk.json (lib/mocks-walk.js) is the one record of what was reached, missed and confirmed, and both event kinds stamp the journey's lastEventAt, which is the seven-day waiver's silence clock. approved now refuses while any seed journey is neither confirmed nor waived (client waive), and client log prints each journey's sentence or its open misses. A client's 違う with a reason promotes into a new said-by-user ledger row, never just a flipped status. 7.136.0 — Hosts can now declare an optional postGateCommand in .claude/spec.config.json: after the scoped build gate passes, spec-build-driver.js chains this command into the same gate run at integration and on every repair round, so a build that passes its own test directories but breaks a repo-wide pin (a version bump, a size ratchet, a read-load budget, a byte-for-byte config pin) is repaired by the build's own workers instead of bouncing red at review. The literal {testCommand} inside postGateCommand substitutes the host's testCommand string; a red post-gate lands REPAIR with a new post-gate: line naming the command in the REPAIR step body, and the build ledger's gate object records whether a post-gate was declared. A host with no such key runs byte-for-byte what it ran before; review's suite leg and the shared gate resolver are unchanged. This repo now declares {testCommand} as its own post-gate. 7.135.0 — The mocks seed now names the client's real records and the two dense screens the theme pick judges every candidate on (ADR-0013): the seed's `## Records` section names one JSON file of at least three real records per entity, refused missing/short/invented at seed-done (and on a cold host the refusal still names the remedy with a literal `<entity>` placeholder); `## Dense screens` accepts one or two declared labels (the singular `## Dense screen` heading still parses for hosts seeded earlier); and journey-drawn now warns per screen and refuses per journey when no drawn screen carries a value from those records, so a journey never reaches the client on placeholder data.
